subject: release of version 0.4 of NIMBLE, including many new features

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: release of version 0.4 of NIMBLE, including many new features
parts:
Dear nimble-users and nimble-announce,

We're pleased to announce that we've released version 0.4 of NIMBLE at
R-nimble.org.

Version 0.4 is a major release. Highlights include allowing users to define
their own functions and distributions for use in BUGS code and handling of
truncation, censoring, and general constraints in BUGS models. In addition,
we added functionality to the NIMBLE algorithm language.
Plus lots of back-end improvements that should result in faster model building,
configuration of MCMCs, and compilation of models and algorithms. More
details on the NIMBLE web page and the NEWS file of the package.

These are still early days for NIMBLE. Please take a moment to let us
know what you're trying to use it for and what would make it better.
You can email the development team directly at nimble...@gmail.com
or share with the nimble-users list at nimble...@googlegroups.com.

- Chris Paciorek for the NIMBLE Development Team
